title: Description of the Osiris Shaft

tellings.quote: So, the Osiris shaft is a three-level structure located on the eastern causeway leading from the central pyramid down to the valley temple and the sphinx. And it's 33-m underground triple chamber system.

plain: Beneath the Giza plateau in Egypt there is said to be a three-level, triple-chamber structure called the Osiris Shaft, cut 33 meters underground. It sits on the eastern causeway, the raised road running from the central pyramid down to the valley temple and the Sphinx. A researcher named Jeffrey Drum describes it this way to Michels, without naming where his account comes from, in an episode about a supposed energy grid under the pyramids.
